# Supabase Postgres PG18 Fork

> Concise LLM entrypoint for the PostgreSQL 18 database-centric fork of `supabase/postgres`.

## Scope

This repository carries the Supabase/Postgres image recipe forward to PostgreSQL 18 and preserves the curated extension/runtime surface where compatible. It also contains a local database-centric proof using PG18 RC1, PostgREST, JWT/RLS, a web proof and an optional WebSocket realtime bridge.

This is an image/build recipe and local proof repository. It is not the full Supabase hosted stack and does not claim production deployment readiness.

## Current release-candidate state

- Branch context: `karval/pg18-bootstrap`
- Accepted PG18 RC digest: `sha256:c477d5146ea51f235b811c093363c3ed5d8a342dbed8efac7635a1b9779e2f9f`
- Digest-pinned image: `registry.arthuragrelli.com/supabase-postgres@sha256:c477d5146ea51f235b811c093363c3ed5d8a342dbed8efac7635a1b9779e2f9f`
- Durable local stack: `docker/pg18-postgrest-rls/`

## Runtime commands

```bash
cd docker/pg18-postgrest-rls
docker compose -f compose.pg18-postgrest-rls.yml up -d --build
curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18083/api/current-profile
curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18083/api/publish-realtime
```

Static gates:

```bash
python3 -m py_compile docker/pg18-postgrest-rls/web/serve.py
node --check docker/pg18-postgrest-rls/realtime/server.js
node --check docker/pg18-postgrest-rls/realtime/test-client.js
docker compose -f docker/pg18-postgrest-rls/compose.pg18-postgrest-rls.yml config
```

## Safety

- Do not print, commit or invent secrets.
- Local compose defaults are development-only placeholders.
- Do not edit runtime code unless the task explicitly authorizes it.
- Do not claim production/VPS readiness without a documented production gate.
- Redis/NATS/Kafka are not mandatory for the current realtime proof.
